q1_issues.issue: 'was expected to strengthen' is an impersonal reported attitude (agentless passive matrix, no Experiencer, content sealed under Theme); the parse drops the expecting event entirely and substitutes the epistemic status (Probably sk_strengthen_1).

One referent gets two different subject roles in one sentence — (Patient sk_move_1 hurricane_claudette) treats the hurricane as a non-volitional natural process, while (Agent sk_makelandfall_1 hurricane_claudette) treats the same subject of the same motion as volitional.

q2_gaps: a proper-noun modifier on a common-noun head ('the Texas coast') — the naming rules cover a lowercase adjective before a name and a kind word inside or beside a name, but not a name modifying a following head noun
directional 'toward' (motion in a direction without reaching it) — Goal is defined for 'to' and records arrival at a destination the sentence does not claim
notes: Sealing both conjuncts under 'forecasters said' while projecting the definite/proper referents (hurricane_claudette, sk_coast_1) at top level is right, as are make_landfall kept whole as one idiom symbol and (Before sk_strengthen_1 sk_makelandfall_1). 'later in the day' correctly copies the antecedent's (Weekday tuesday) by term propagation, though the ordering 'later' states relative to the moving is not recorded.
